extracted.intended_audience: policy professionals (lobbyists, analysts, researchers, consultants, government affairs teams)
extracted.subtask_description: Marketing/product page describing POLITICO Pro's features and value proposition as a policy intelligence and public affairs software platform for tracking, researching, and engaging on legislation, regulation, and stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage of policy areas
rubrics_metrics.description: POLITICO subject matter experts cover 22 government policy areas to help push policy goals forward; includes a long list of verticals (Agriculture, Budget & Appropriations, Campaigns, Cannabis, Cybersecurity, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The product emphasizes breadth across federal and state policy areas, and claims expanded state coverage (e.g., a large California newsroom) to tie state decisions to national outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness and real-time alerts
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides relevant, real-time news, insights, and automatic tracking of government affairs and policy, with a daily breakdown delivered to your inbox at 6AM and key articles sent throughout the day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to keep users 'in the know' as developments happen; supports immediate awareness for policy action and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specialist reporting and expert journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: Exclusive, breaking scoops from specialists in policy areas; boasts expert field reporters and named reporters (e.g., Victoria Guida, David Lim) as subject matter experts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims journalistic expertise as a key quality dimension—depth, specialist knowledge, and scoops that cut through clutter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customizable dashboard and workflow integration
rubrics_metrics.description: A customizable home dashboard consolidates trending news, articles, policy explainers, infographics, and tools to track, organize, and share information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dashboard customization is presented as central to adapting the product to an organization's workflow and priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directories of decision-makers and contact info
rubrics_metrics.description: Directories updated daily covering key decision-makers across Capitol Hill, state and federal agencies, including bios, headshots, committees, and contact information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positioned as a one-stop reference for stakeholders, staffers, and committees to support outreach and relationship-building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative and regulatory tracking (Policy Trackers)
rubrics_metrics.description: POLICY TRACKERS: Legislative Compass, Regulatory Compass, and Dialogue Tracking to follow legislation, regulations, and dialogues users care about; provides bill texts and actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracking tools are intended to save time and provide continuous visibility on legislative/regulatory movement relevant to users' interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dialogue Tracking / Public comments monitoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Dialogue Tracking to seamlessly monitor public comments and gain insight into the rulemaking process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit capability to surface and follow public comment activity and the stages of rulemaking—useful for engagement and timing of advocacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to primary source documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Document drawer provides original source documents including transcripts, agency documents, and bill texts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A centralized repository of source materials simplifies research and enables quick reference to primary texts for analysis or comment drafting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pro Analysis modules (Issue, Data, Bill, Stakeholder Analysis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pro Analysis helps understand power, market, and policy dynamics with tools like Pro Issue Analysis, Pro Data Analysis, Pro Bill Analysis, and Stakeholder Analysis, offering simplified explanations of complex topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analysis products are framed to translate complex policy information into actionable insight for strategy and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stakeholder management and engagement capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify, track, and engage networks of influencers and organizations; stakeholder management features help develop relationships and make the most of opportunities in legislation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tools support strategic outreach, relationship-building, and maintaining an engagement plan tied to policy goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pro Briefings — concise expert summaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefings delivered by reporting experts in a weekly cadence; succinct source of content covering elections, energy, health care, defense, finance, technology, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Briefings are described as a packaged, recurring stream of expert insight intended for quick assimilation by policy teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role-specific customization and outputs
rubrics_metrics.description: Product positions tailored functionality for distinct users—analysts (digestible detail, personalized feeds), researchers (cross-referencing tools, comprehensive directories), lobbyists (targeted insights), and consultants (real-time updates and research tools).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes different feature/value expectations depending on user role and use case.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-referencing and research tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Easy-to-use tools for cross-referencing related bills, regulations, campaigns, and more to connect information across the policy ecosystem.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports faster, more authoritative research by linking related materials and actors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event discovery and filtering (Event Calendar)
rubrics_metrics.description: Calendar Events page allows filtering by topic, date, and event type to locate events in a policy area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps users identify opportunities for engagement or information-gathering tied to timing and topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data visualizations and analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides extensive data visualizations (1k+ claimed) and data analysis capabilities to elucidate policy and market dynamics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visual analytics are presented as tools to make complex trends and relationships easier to understand and present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-partisan framing and editorial standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to critical non-partisan news and in-depth analysis from POLITICO journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions the product as neutral, authoritative reporting intended to inform rather than advocate.
